text:
Devon Li: quick handoff — I'm wrapping up. Short summary: two small issues, one ongoing alert on regen-eu (high latency for >512 tokens), and a failed canary rollout to dedicated-pool-3. Mitigations in place: routing to fallback-model-small for regen-eu, canary rolled back to previous image.
Alex Chen: thanks. regen-eu latency — any indication it's KV-cache misses or infra (GPU preemption)?
Devon Li: looks like KV-cache miss + one node with elevated GC. metrics: kv_cache_hit_rate dropped ~12% on host eu-gpu-07, and that host shows higher p99 lat. I've drained and cordoned the node.
Maria Gomez: re: canary, what was the failure mode? logs?
Devon Li: canary failed healthcheck after ~30s, error was java.lang.OutOfMemoryError in transformer-serving process (we're investigating memory config). Rolling back restored healthy state.
Sasha Patel: I pushed a quick alert playbook update: added a runbook step to check node memory cgroups and the model config memory limits. Also added a note to try lighter quantization if memory spikes persist. :memo:
oncall-bot: Alert: regen-eu latency > p95 threshold (automated), count=6 in 10m.
Jamal Rivers: I'll take next shift. I'll keep an eye on eu-gpu-07, and if kv cache hit rate doesn't recover in 15m I'll trigger a kvcache prewarm via the prewarm job.
Alex Chen: for the canary follow-up, assign a small spike test on staging with same input distribution? I can run that.
Devon Li: yes please, Alex — run spike with 600-1200 token samples, check RSS and OOMs. I added the failing container logs to the incident thread.
Maria Gomez: blocker: need approval to bump dedicated-pool-3 memory limit for a short test (5m). Who can approve?
Sasha Patel: I can approve for a controlled test window. Schedule it and add rollback step.
Jamal Rivers: noted — I'll trigger prewarm if hit rate < 85% after 10m. Also will monitor autoscaler behaves for fallback routing.
Devon Li: handoff checklist for Jamal: 1) monitor regen-eu p95/p99, 2) watch node eu-gpu-07 until drain completes, 3) verify canary remains rolled back and schedule spike test with Alex tomorrow morning, 4) escalate to platform if OOMs reproduce on 2 nodes.
Alex Chen: will run spike now, report back if I see memory growth.
Maria Gomez: leaving a doc link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/regen-eu-latency — updated steps.
Devon Li: thanks all. ping me if anything degrades, otherwise sync tomorrow 09:15 UTC for follow-up. :thumbsup:
